findings.description: This accepted answer omits the obligatory comma separating the vocative «Ana». It therefore accepts incorrect Spanish. The policy's case and final-punctuation allowances do not remove internal comma requirements.
findings.suggestion: Remove a3. Its correctly punctuated form, «Gracias, Ana. ¡Hasta mañana!», is already accepted as a1.

items.reviewerAnswer: I would transcribe: «Gracias, Ana. ¡Hasta mañana!» Neutral punctuation, «Gracias, Ana. Hasta mañana.», is also acceptable.
items.notes: The finding concerns the written key and does not require access to the audio.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «coma», rule on separating vocatives with commas (from memory).
Course contract, rule 3: accepted answers must be acceptable answers.
Course contract, rule 8: Spanish must be correct.
